scope: Actual retained source40km contours and original levels through production bake/symbol/terrain-only projection; controlled flat receiver and blue palette. Not a fresh neural/Terrain3D/production-style/canopy/topology or constant-width perspective proof.

source.generation: Retained V8 teacher source; not newly generated/refined for this control

runtime.sourceDigestScope: Post-run digests; these production modules/shaders and GPU probe were not edited during or after this GPU run

display.palette: Controlled blue palette, all water kinds; flat grey layer1 receiver and red layer2 roof

original.sourceLevelBoundaryPolicy: Only queries of float64-clipped vertices displaced outside source support by <= half an FP32 relative-coordinate ULP are clamped; source levels and mesh vertices stay unchanged
original.sourceVectorAreaScope: input geometry clip window; projection camera may be narrower
original.subpixelPolicy: original contour coverage only; no minimum stroke or physical-width edits
original.symbolColorPolicy: nearest contributing source coverage colour; no new hydrology classes
original.symbolRasterLimit: A segment absent from the initial AA source raster cannot be reconstructed by dilation
original.symbolWidthMeaning: AA disk diameter around nonzero coverage samples; not a measured or edited physical water width

symbolic.sourceLevelBoundaryPolicy: Only queries of float64-clipped vertices displaced outside source support by <= half an FP32 relative-coordinate ULP are clamped; source levels and mesh vertices stay unchanged
symbolic.sourceVectorAreaScope: input geometry clip window; projection camera may be narrower
symbolic.subpixelPolicy: declared all-water coverage symbol; original source contours, levels and physical area unchanged
symbolic.symbolColorPolicy: nearest contributing source coverage colour; no new hydrology classes
symbolic.symbolRasterLimit: A segment absent from the initial AA source raster cannot be reconstructed by dilation
symbolic.symbolWidthMeaning: AA disk diameter around nonzero coverage samples; not a measured or edited physical water width

roofImageControl.scope: Saved identical-camera GPU images, interior of the actual red roof bounds; confirms that terrain-only symbols are occluded by layer2 geometry. No additional GPU run.

validation.tests: 6 TS evidence cases including negative matrices; native CPU plan/cache/empty contracts; headless probe parse; saved-image CPU roof control

visualInspection: Mode0 and1.25 captures opened: regional network becomes substantially easier to follow; some very thin branches still intermittent. No complete flow/topology/constant-width or artistic acceptance claimed.
limitations: Actual retained contours/levels and production projection/symbol modules, but controlled receiver/palette; not a Terrain3D main scene or fresh E2E proof.
All-water AA disk symbology; no river-only classification, new centreline, source widening, level editing or rerouting.
Initial AA raster can miss a sufficiently thin segment entirely; post-process cannot recover absent coverage.
Estimated image workspace excludes engine-owned framebuffer/MSAA/depth attachments and rest of scene; cache and full-scene memory require separate measurement.
Uniform ground-scale symbols are exact-screen controls only for top orthographic mapping; oblique use is explicitly approximate.
Historical V8/other failed campaigns remain unchanged.
